'''0.13b''' is a minor update for [[Survarium]] that improved game logging and fixed various crashes and synchronization issues.

==Changelog==
* The client creates a new type of game log - event log. The event log contains enough information to reproduce the full history of the battle. The event log is added by default to submit the bug report
* Fixed a bug where one player going out of sync led to having to resync all the players of the current game
* Fixed formula of restricting standard distribution when shooting. Changed all weapons to use the new formula
* Included a correction of finger positions on guns

===Bug fixes===
* Fixed out of sync computing in the physical controller players
* Fixed out of sync at the spawn of a character
* Fixed a bug that caused a chain of de-sync (for the time when there is a new resynchronization out of sync)
* Fixed a crash when using the first aid kit
* Fixed a server crash match after the final score
* Fixed a crash when the game server destroys an anomaly
* Fixed a rare crash when the game server destroys a player
* Fixed a rare crash when the game server disconnects a player
* Fixed a crash when stopping in torrent the loader client
* Now loader checks for available disk space before downloading new updates
